messages:
Jordan: noticed a confusing interaction on the infra panel: when multiple units are present the legend groups randomly and the axis unit pill moves. repro: open panel with >6 series and mixed units (ms, req/s, %). screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/legend-mixup.png
Mei: saw this too. The grouping is client-side and uses string matching on the series name which is brittle. we should group by a unit field from the API instead.
Carlos: agree. api change: add `unit` and `canDenoise` flags per-series so the client can reliably group and offer denoise options. sample: 
```json
{"seriesId":"db-read","unit":"ms","canDenoise":"true"}
```
Anya: microcopy: for collapsed groups suggest: "Other (6) — low activity". also recommend showing a keyboard hint: "(Press L to open)" next to the collapse affordance.
Jordan: UX idea: priority pin (pin icon) — pinned series stay at top regardless of ranking. pin should be reversible and persisted per user.
Mei: keyboard/accessibility notes: pinned state needs aria-pressed and the pin control should be reachable via Tab. when ranking changes (raw vs smoothed) announce it with aria-live: e.g., "Legend: ranking switched to smoothed values".
Carlos: denoise vs attenuation clarification: denoise = smooth series client-side (affects line shape); attenuation = reduce marker prominence only. both useful. propose distinct controls in legend: a toggle for denoise (global + per-series) and a small menu for attenuation levels (none/soft/strong).
Anya: yes. microcopy for denoise tooltip: "Temporarily smooth short-lived spikes to compare baseline trends." for attenuation tooltip: "Fade spike markers to emphasize trend lines." keep both under 120 chars.
Jordan: visual treatment: when a series is denoised show a subtle badge in the legend item: "smoothed" with low-contrast bg. when attenuation is active show a small dot icon with reduced opacity.
Mei: implementation CSS snippet: ```css
.legend-item .badge { background: #F4F6F8; font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; }
.marker-attenuate { opacity: 0.6; r: 4px; transition: opacity .12s, r .12s; }
```
Carlos: API contract note: send `rawValue` and `smoothedValue` strings in timeseries meta so the legend can display both: e.g., "120ms (smoothed: 95ms)". also include `spikeFlag` boolean so client knows which series have recent outliers.
Anya: accessibility tweak: ensure the legend collapse control has aria-controls linking to the expanded list and SR text like "expand legend, 6 hidden"; provide keyboard shortcut L to focus and Enter to toggle.
Jordan: UX question: should ranking default to raw or smoothed? I'm leaning raw to avoid hiding real spikes; add an explicit "rank by smoothed" menu item if people want that.
Mei: +1 for raw default. show current ranking method in legend header with an info tooltip that explains the difference.
Carlos: performance note: computing smoothedValue server-side is cheap if we return an optional smoothed aggregate in the query. we can do it in the time-series pipeline and avoid client computation.
Anya: action items: Carlos -> draft API change (unit, canDenoise, spikeFlag, rawValue, smoothedValue); Mei -> accessibility spec + SR messages; Jordan -> mock pinned + denoise/attenuate states and microcopy; I'll schedule a 25m sync Thursday.
frontend-bot: Prototype uploaded: https://redwood.example/design/legend-priority-denoise-ux.png :sparkles:
